Functions and arrow functions

Functions package reusable behavior. Normal functions have call-dependent this; arrows
capture surrounding this and cannot be used as constructors.
Function එකක් නැවත භාවිත කළ හැකි code block එකක්. Arrow function එකට තමන්Jගේ this
